gate_claims.claim: the card holds equivalence.run, which is AVAILABLE, so the first line says Practising
the gate takes only the Yosys commands in its allow list (26 named) in [gold], [gate] and [script]
any Yosys command outside the allow list is refused
abc, sat, sim, select and show are refused
the gate takes only the sections [options], [gold], [gate], [script], [match], [collect], [partition], [recode] and [strategy]
any other section is refused
under [options] only splitnets or insbuf, each on or off
any other option line is refused
a [strategy] takes use sat or sby, plain depth and timeout, xprop on or off
any other strategy line is refused
a strategy's option lines are refused
an engine line takes only smtbmc, abc, btor, aiger or none, each with a fixed set of solver words
an engine line outside those words is refused
equivalence.run takes the setup in eqy and optionally the RTL it must read in sources
a script line that reaches outside Yosys (a shell, exec, tcl, python, script, plugin) is refused
a script that writes a file (write_*, tee, dump) is refused
both outside-Yosys and write refusals are exercised
a setup with no [gold] or no [gate] section is refused
a setup whose [gold] and [gate] command lists are identical is refused; [script] lines are shared and not part of that comparison
the identical-script refusal is exercised
two sides that read the same file with different commands are accepted (inference from the comparison of scripts, not file names)
a read by an absolute path or outside the setup's own folder is refused
a read of a file that is not there is refused
given sources, the setup must read every one of them, compared by resolved path
a source the setup does not read fails the run
the run copies the setup and the files it reads into its own directory
the run records the files each side read
the copies leave the submitted files unchanged
a run passes only when eqy exited 0, said DONE (PASS) and that the designs were proved equivalent, proved at least one partition, and failed none
a setup that proves no partition fails, and the summary says nothing was proved
a partition not proved fails and names the first partition
the result names the gold and the gate files and the partition count
the summary text naming gate and gold files
with the installed eqy and Yosys, use sat at depth 10 reports a register partition of a wrong design equivalent and use sby with smtbmc reports it not equivalent
a sby strategy listed after a sat strategy that proves the partition is not reached (the file's order, marked inference)
one setup is submitted per run, so the seat cannot mutation-test its own setup (marked inference)
the gate counts partitions, not outputs (marked inference)
